Visitor replaces emphasis with custom output

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
visitor = Class.new do
  def visit_emphasis(ctx, text)
    { custom: ">>>#{text}<<<" }
  end
end.new
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>This is <em>important</em> text.</p>', visitor)
puts result.inspect
```
